name: readingjournal
description: The idea behind the website was to have a way for me to keep logs of everything I have done.   The primary use case is for me to keep tracks of comics that I have read.   It should prove very useful for keeping track of the amount of chapters I have read, what my thoughts on it were and other similar features.   It can grow in the future to other things I could keep a log of, like restaurants I liked or movies I enjoyed.
